newsitem.title: BELGIUM: DEGROOF LIFTS ASTURIENNE TO BUY FROM HOLD.
newsitem.headline: DEGROOF LIFTS ASTURIENNE TO BUY FROM HOLD.

text.p: Belgian Bank Degroof said on Thursday it upgraded its recommendation on shares in Cie. Royale Asturienne Des Mines to buy from hold, describing the stock as one of the most atractive on the Brussels bourse.
"At 1,070 francs per share Asturienne offers an opportunity to buy into a high-quality industrial company which is fundamentally under-valued," analyst Alexandre Schmitz said.

"While the Asturienne share has been a good investment for fixed income investors over the past two years, it will from now on be increasingly valorized on the basis of its fundamental industrial and financial prospects," he noted in a report.

Asturienne, which operates non-ferrous metals mines in Morocco and a U.S. mica mine, is controlled by French holding company Cie. Fonciere du Chateau d'Eau de Paris (FOCEP), which forms part of Switzerland's Harwanne Group.
